title: Packers list Micah Parsons, Josh Jacobs as questionable for Wednesday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers list Micah Parsons, Josh Jacobs as questionable for Wednesday
sources.description: Micah Parsons has been cleared to make his return from last December's torn ACL, but the Packers didn't make anything certain about the defensive end's status for Wednesday night's game against the Rams on their final injury report.
